3) Questionnaire: attaching our vendor security questionnaire (PDF). Please have your security/compliance SME complete or indicate which sections we can accept as evidence and which require additional artifacts.

Can you loop in the right folks and provide target dates? Aim is to have the questionnaire back in two weeks if possible.

Hi Michael / Marissa — pulling together our responses below and attaching a short SSO/SCIM config checklist for Okta. Quick answers up-front: 

- SOC 2: Our Type II report was completed in March 2025. Attached is a SOC 2 summary and auditor name; the full report requires an NDA — we can provide it under an approved request. In-scope: production serving infrastructure, authentication & access controls, incident response. Excluded: non-prod experimental research clusters.

- SAML/SCIM support:
  * SAML 2.0 SP: Yes — we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; metadata and ACS endpoints included in the attached guide.
  * SCIM: Yes — SCIM 2.0 provisioning API available for user and group sync. Rate limits documented in the guide.
  * RBAC: Role hierarchy with least-privilege admin roles; ability to restrict keys and grant read-only vs admin console access. Audit logs for admin actions are retained per customer tenancy retention settings.

See attached: SSO_SAML_Config_Guide.pdf (configuration checklist for Okta), and a short stub of our SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf).

Planned deliverables and dates:
- 2026-05-18: annotated vendor questionnaire (initial pass)
- 2026-05-20: schedule 30-min technical walkthrough with Okta team (Monica to confirm)

If you share any specific questionnaire IDs that require evidence (e.g., control numbers), call them out and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
